correctness.rationale: A pp formula in the integer-module language is an existential integer-matrix kernel projection; exact cardinality follows by dividing full kernel size by witness-only kernel size. Smith normal form yields n^a times finitely many integer gcd factors. Positivity forces a>=0 by evaluation at large primes; a>0 exceeds any fixed invariant threshold eventually; a=0 is controlled by finitely many capped valuations. The finite signature includes all small primes and a small/large indicator; both directions of the bounded-morphism property are explicitly constructed. Its finite directed poset image validates Grz.2. Prime-order-element FO sentences give bounded morphisms onto finite Boolean cubes with all valuations definable; external finite-cube Grz.2 completeness produces the converse. The standalone checker additionally passed 13,418 back-lift, 2,020 cube-lift and 1,900 one-matrix count tests. None of the finite tests is presented as an infinite proof.
